text: Home Depot named CFO Richard McPhail as incoming CEO, Ann-Marie Campbell as president and COO, and Jordan Broggi as incoming CFO. Outgoing CEO Ted Decker retains the board chairmanship. Q3 revenue rose 4.9% YoY to $43.4 billion, with comparable sales up 2.2%.

meta.note: Appointments are announced but not yet effective; earnings provide concurrent operating context.
